claim_limit: The run stopped before the predeclared 600 rounds and is not a performance or qualification sample. It is retained as a semantics counterexample for sequential outcome replay.
correction: At the common cutoff, remove the complete observed-success set in one atomic transition and rebuild the current-time certificate only from unresolved accepted recovery obligations.
diagnosis: A launch-time retry reconstructed the current state by replaying already-observed NeuralRx successes one at a time. At the later retry time an intermediate partial-success state was infeasible even though the physically observed success set was simultaneous at the common cutoff. The runtime therefore rejected a state that never existed.
